title: A Space with no rating shows no "Ratings, coming soon" box on its Spotlight or website

source.ref: Live-surface audit 2026-11-02 (audits/live-surface-audit-2026-11-02.md); govanta.pro renders the box

verify.note: Fails before the fix: the block's fallback is an EmptyState reading Ratings, coming soon.

detail: Member reviews are off by owner decision, so every Space without an operator-entered rating published an empty on-the-way box (seen live on govanta.pro). The block now renders nothing until a rating exists.
